v.1: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can't be moved.
v.2: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
v.3: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, The floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
v.4: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
v.5: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forevermore.
